# Billing page — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the billing page when the tenant needs to see the plan and the invoices and nothing else. It is display slots all the way down — `plan` plus `invoiceColumns` and `invoiceRows` — and the invoice grid rides the ledger preset with no selection and no row actions, so a payment cannot start by construction: a display grid that could start one would be a defect, not a feature. There are no pay, top-up or payout actions anywhere in it, and there is no fetching either — columns and rows arrive as props while `loading` only paints the skeleton. `planLabel`, `invoicesLabel` and `invoicesEmpty` name the two regions and the empty state, and `children` slots extra display content like usage meters around them.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the billing page when the tenant needs to see the plan and the invoices and nothing else — the native twin of the web page under the same contract. `plan` plus the native invoice columns and rows are display slots only, and the invoice grid keeps the ledger shape with no selection and no row actions, so a payment cannot start by construction. There are no pay, top-up or payout actions and no fetching: everything arrives as props while `loading` paints the skeleton, and no invoices renders the section empty state. Plan and invoices render as two labelled sections, so the page announces as regions with the title naming the whole.
